purpose: Fresh clean proof of runtime postcondition fallback with no capability acquisition for control flow.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/this-endpoint-does-not-exist, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_PRIMARY.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_PRIMARY.json. If the rendered primary result is not a JSON array containing at least one item, fall back to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_SECONDARY.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_SECONDARY.json. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_DECISION.json containing primary_url, fallback_url, used_fallback, final_url, and item_count. Finally independently verify the primary result was not a nonempty JSON array, the fallback result was a nonempty JSON array, used_fallback is true, final_url is the fallback URL, and item_count equals the fallback array length.
